messages:
Jun Park: hey folks! Jun here — joining as a product manager on infra. moved up from seattle, big fan of late-night ramen, banjo + bad puns. dropped by the office today and grabbed a sticker pack. who else is into sticker trades? :wave: 
Alex: welcome Jun!! :tada: we have a sticker shelf by the kitchen (next to the kombucha). if you left a little label i'll stash some for you.
Riley: welcome!! team lunch friday? maybe a karaoke after if ppl are into it :microphone: 
Sam (People Ops): welcome Jun — onboarding checklist slid into your DMs. ping me if you want a standing desk or a monitor arm. also FYI we'll do a photo for the directory at 11.
Marisol: hi Jun! i can bring a pothos cutting if you want a desk plant. low light friendly.
Jun Park: say less — pothos forever. also i brought a tiny hot sauce collection if anyone wants to form a condiment club :hot_pepper: 
Eli: i volunteer to test the sauces. and also i'll take monday breakfast duties next week :croissant: 
DeployBot: pinned files updated in #new-hires — welcome packet uploaded. use `/onboard confirm Jun Park` when you're set.
Todd: also banjo + ramen? i'm intrigued. if you actually bring a banjo on Friday, i'm buying the first round of snacks. :cookie: 
Jun Park: challenge accepted — will bring the banjo and maybe my vintage capo. coffee meetup at 10 for quick hellos? :coffee:
Alex: i'll be there. also FYI there's a monthly sticker swap shelf label in the kitchen — add whatever you want.
Riley: see you at 10 — and extra :clap: for banjo night.
Jun Park: thanks everyone — excited to be here! will DM folks to coordinate plant and sticker trades :)
